facts.value: Implements a kind-dependent demo-fighter creation branch. It selects the numeric WalkSlow motion state for Mario/Luigi after demo creation installs alternate motion-state lists, and RebirthWait through the fallback for other kinds. This does not establish a revival-platform respawn role or ordinary gameplay slow-walk animation.
facts.rationale: Current demo dispatcher and alternate-table evidence contradict the archived respawn-specific interpretation or assumed paired-entry precondition.

evidence.why: Mario/Luigi WalkSlow branch, fixed parameters and flags.
Three inline wrappers forward to fallback.
Fallback enters RebirthWait and sets identical flags.
Both exported void fighter-object signatures.
Slot10 initializer in demo creation table.
Demo creation installs alternate motion-state lists.
Creation dispatches by alloc_info->unk8.
Companion in second alternate Mario record, submotion label Kneebend.
Corresponding alternate Luigi record.
